$comment: Decision 0019 implements Decision 0014 gate G5. This is the explicit arcade modifier and the honest home of what used to be silent canon. Three knockdowns in a round stops the bout; four in a bout stops it. Keeping them is a deliberate arcade choice, and selecting it is visible in every stream and replay.
name: Project Uppercut Arcade Three-Knockdown Rule

referee_stoppage.note: Permitted but not modelled. Under this ruleset it matters less than under the professional one because the knockdown limits may end the bout first.

notes: For arcade exhibitions and special events. It may not silently define a professional fight.
